attributes.title: read_reference_document
attributes.description: Returns the full text of one hosted reference document by filename. Use it to read the PLC tag export you are importing, and to read the supporting material (ladder-logic description, code lookups) when you need it to decide how tags group. Call list_reference_documents first if you do not know the filename. Reading the primary tag export also stages it, so save_proposal can attach your proposal to it.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Exact filename from list_reference_documents, e.g. 'Line1_ControllerTags_Export.CSV'. Omit to read the primary tag export.
